meta.source_workbook: calc.xlsm (Haulage Calculator Spreadsheet, Short Term Planning)
meta.float_note: All numbers are IEEE-754 doubles exactly as cached by Excel (JSON repr round-trips).
meta.description: Every haul string in the 'Raw Data' sheet (rolling history of Deswik/Vulcan string exports), parsed into named options. Use as demo haul strings.
meta.format_note: Each block = title row (col A title, col I/J truck note, col M/P flags) + header row ('No.','T','ype','Colour','X','Y','Z','W Name' - Vulcan export split oddly by text-to-columns) + point rows. Only X/Y/Z (cols E/F/G) are meaningful; col B holds the point number mis-parsed as a time, col C the Vulcan point type (0=first/move, 1=draw), col D '...', col H 0. Blocks from row 835 onwards contain only E/F/G.
meta.geometry_summary_note: length/net rise computed by the extractor (not cells in the workbook).
